The '''LX-4 proton mine''' was a self-detonating defensive [[Mine/Legends|mine]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] for use by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

The LX-4 made use of a refitted [[Proton torpedo/Legends|Proton torpedo]] warhead for both anti-vehicle and anti-personnel use. The mine was buried to a depth of half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] as part of creating an effective defensive perimeter. It utilized two [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suites: a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]-sensitive sensor which detected the magnetic disturbances of passing vehicles, and a [[Infrared motion sensor|thermal sensor]] which detected body heat. An intruder detected within five meters of the mine would cause it to detonate.

Once set, the LX-4 could not be disarmed except by detonation, which was considered a major drawback of its use. This design feature was created in response to an incident involving [[LX-2 comlink mine]]s on the world of [[Calonica]].
